opportunities.title: Hugh Phillips Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree; retrospective applications not considered.
opportunities.summary: Annual research grant under the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme funding research into the material past (Britain pre-1800).

opportunities.title: Margaret and Tom Jones Memorial Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Two references required. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: Annual research grant under the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme funding research into the material past.

opportunities.title: Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: Annual research grant under the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme funding research archaeology in Wales.

opportunities.title: Open Research Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: Annual research grant under the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme funding research into the material past with no period, geographic or disciplinary restrictions.

opportunities.title: Beatrice de Cardi Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Two references required.
opportunities.summary: Annual research grant under the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme funding research into the archaeology of Arabia and the Gulf region.

opportunities.title: Janet Arnold Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Annual research grant under the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme funding research into dress and textiles, including the history of clothing and costume.

opportunities.title: Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Reduced reporting requirements apply to Wheeler and Lambarde Travel Awards.
opportunities.summary: Annual travel awards under the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme supporting research travel.

opportunities.title: William Lambarde Travel Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Reduced reporting requirements apply to Wheeler and Lambarde Travel Awards.
opportunities.summary: Annual travel awards under the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme supporting research travel, particularly for researchers requiring funds primarily for their own research travel.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made via the Grants Application Portal. No references required. Supporting documents such as photographs, architect/conservation reports or budgets must be uploaded.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of church fabric and monuments, with two application rounds each year.

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made via the Grants Application Portal selecting the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants form. No references required.
opportunities.summary: Grants for textile conservation and research, applied for through the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants application form.
